notes: DOCUMENT vs CHUNK FILE - A LOUD CONTRADICTION ON THE SEAT. The chunk file and the source filename both say 'Commission Seat C'. The document's own TITLE LINE reads 'COUNTY COMMISSION SEAT A CANDIDATE FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT'. The form's Office line reads only 'County Commission' (Representative District: 'Washington County'; 'in the Washington County Commission') - it names NO seat letter. So the form contradicts the label on the seat, and the form itself is internally silent on which seat. Transcribed from the form; the seat letter should be treated as unresolved by this document. Candidate name agrees: 'Dean J. Cox'. County office, in scope. PERIOD LINE IS STALE AND THE FILER LEFT IT SO: the certification reads 'for the period beginning February 1, 2016 and ending April 15, 2016', but the report is dated 6/16/16, the channel filename says 6/14/2016, and 27 of the 53 transcribed transactions are dated after April 15 (the last is 06/13/16). The period sentence is a stale template line, not a scope statement; every row was still transcribed verbatim with its own date and the totals close, which is the evidence the schedules cover the whole Feb-June span. Every row date is therefore reported as printed and NO date was adjusted. THIS IS NOT A GENERATION 1 OR GENERATION 2 COUNTY FORM: it is a typed word-processor rendition on landscape letter (2200x1700 at 200 dpi) using the statutory headings, citing Utah Code 20A-11-1301 through 20A-11-1305 rather than 17-16-6.5 or the county ordinance. Form A has NO in-kind column, and each schedule prints ONE grand total, not a per-page subtotal. The cover claims 'The law is also printed on page four of this report' but page four is in fact the Form B continuation - there is no statute page in this PDF. index.csv calls this filing format 'text' and it IS born-digital with a real text layer; it was nevertheless read as page images per the wave contract, with the text layer used once, as an escalation, on a single visually-clipped cell. The candidate self-funded heavily: four rows are the candidate himself (1,000 + 500 + 12,000 + 4,000 = $17,500 of the $24,690), and his own home street address appears as a donor address - street lines and ZIPs were discarded at read time, city and state only retained. Candidate home address and both phone numbers on the cover likewise discarded.
